name: The Dominator Table
description: Mathlib constants ranked by how many theorems each is uniquely responsible for making classical — the number that would stop depending on the axiom of choice if that constant alone were rebuilt. Computed as a dominator tree over the reversed dependency graph rooted at the axiom.
